Network analysis of significantly enriched KEGG pathways in Ogg1Tgskeletal muscle

Network analysis of significantly enriched KEGG pathways in Ogg1Tgskeletal muscle. Protein–protein interaction networks (A–C) of significantly enriched KEGG pathways using the differentially expressed genes from the Ogg1Tg skeletal muscle and their closely connected nodes. Pathways in cancer (A) and the MAPK signaling pathway (B) show a strong representation of immune signature genes and nutrient deprivation. The Ribosome (C) pathway shows upregulation of ribosome biogenesis. The pathways have a false discovery rate <0.01 and p < 0.05. The networks had a confidence (score) cutoff of 0.8 and a degree cutoff of 1. The color indicates the fold change gradient from −1 to 1, and the node size indicates the degree of interaction with other nodes. KEGG, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes; MAPK, mitogen-activated protein kinase
